description: Hands supplies structure, verification and execution; your own model supplies drafts and decisions, and no platform model is called. action=create starts a run from a goal (mode preview runs the loop in a throwaway context and never commits; mode run commits after verification and policy). action=advance sends facts you found (each with its sources), a batch of actions to execute, or finish. A contradicted fact blocks the run until it is found again. When the approval policy asks, the run is awaiting_user with a pending_request to relay to the user; reply with action=answer. action=status returns the run and action=events returns events after a seq cursor (the same stream the CLI and the Playground Studio read).

act.description: Advance: the batch to execute, as for alterlab_task_act

after.description: Events: return events with seq greater than this

answer.description: Answer: the user's words for a question

facts.description: Advance: facts you found, each with evidence

finish.description: Advance: you are done; ends the run with a receipt

goal.description: Create: the goal in the user's words

graph.description: Create: optional task graph you propose; validated, never executed as given

policy_ref.description: Create: approval-policy label the run's actions match

run_id.description: Required for advance, answer, status and events

target.description: Create: what the run acts on

name: alterlab_hands_run
title: Hands Delegated Run
